notes.safety_note: The label does not contain a BOXED WARNING. The main safety warnings in section 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS include: anesthesia effects (cholinesterase inhibitor may exaggerate succinylcholine-type muscle relaxation), cardiovascular conditions (may cause bradycardia, heart block, or syncopal episodes), nausea and vomiting, peptic ulcer disease and GI bleeding, weight loss, genitourinary conditions (bladder outflow obstruction), seizures, and pulmonary conditions.
